title: Large performance gains

features.alt: Up to 10x faster UI, 5x faster inference, and 3x more file types
features.title: Faster everywhere
features.summary: The app is up to 10x faster with several chats open, and inference up to 5x faster.

changes: Compaction works with every API connection.
Drag and drop works again on Desktop, with over 3x more file types.
Models can click, drag, and run approved scripts, with per-site rules.
Generate video with LTX-2.5 and Wan2.2, including image-to-video.
